messages:
Alex (Sales): Handoff: Rivermoss (mid-market). Signed 2024-06-01, 12mo. Dedicated trial in us-west. Onboarding ~60% — SSO failing (Okta cert) and batch ingest 5xx. Renewal risk: medium if we don't resolve infra+enablement by next quarter.

Maria (CS): I'll own onboarding and enablement. Need Sam/Carla contact, sample logs, and can we do enablement Wed 09:00 PT? They also want model routing & cost controls overview.

Alex (Sales): Contacts: sam@rivermoss.com (Platform Lead), carla@rivermoss.com (PM). Intro email going out; Sam ok with scoped log upload. Onboarding assets: https://drive.redwood/rivermoss/onboarding-snapshot

Jon (Eng): Reproduced the Okta error: "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority". Opening ENG-7892. Patch is config-only but requires a backend restart of rivermoss-dedicated-01. Need IdP metadata XML or cert from customer.

Maria (CS): If restart needed, we'll schedule maintenance with customer. I'll coordinate calendar invites.

Lisa (Support): Creating SUPPORT-3421 and a synthetic monitor on the ingest endpoint. Alerting rule: page oncall + Jon if 5xx rate >1% over 5m.

infra-bot: Maintenance request queued for rivermoss-dedicated-01. Queue position: 3. Please confirm ETA in ENG-7892.

Alex (Sales): Sam replied: uploading IdP metadata + sanitized CSV to shared folder. Preferred maintenance Tue 15:00-16:00 PT and asks for 30m pre-call.

Jon (Eng): ENG-7892: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7892. PR ready. I can apply config and restart Tue 15:10 PT after pre-call. Will monitor health post-restart.

Maria (CS): Owners & next steps:
- Maria: lead onboarding, run enablement Wed 09:00 PT, collect feedback.
- Jon: apply Okta config (ENG-7892), restart host rivermoss-dedicated-01.
- Lisa: SUPPORT-3421, monitors & escalation.
- Alex: customer liaison and log/metadata collection.

Maria (CS): I'll create Jira epic CS-1220 and link ENG-7892 + SUPPORT-3421. Internal sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm go/no-go.

Alex (Sales): Renewal flag set to "monitoring" in CRM. I'll review adoption metrics in 30 days. Use this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
